```js
      details: row[4] || ''
    };

  });
  const perUser = {};
  let logins = 0;
  rows.forEach(function (row) {
    const email = row.email || '(system)';
    if (!perUser[email]) perUser[email] = { email: email, actions: 0, logins: 0, lastSeenMs: 0, lastSeen: '' };

    }

  });
  const userList = Object.keys(perUser).map(...).sort by actions desc;
  return { users: userList, recent: recent, totals: {...} };
}
```

```js
function auditTimestampMs_(value) {
  const d = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  const t = d.getTime();
  return isFinite(t) ? t : 0;
}

function getAuditEntries(limit) {
  requireViewer();
  const sheet = getAuditSheet_();
  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return [];
  const rows = sheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 5).getValues();
  return rows
    .map(function (row, i) {
      const ts = auditTimestampMs_(row[0]);
      return {
        row: i + 2,
        timestamp: row[0] ? row[0].toString() : '',
        timestampMs: ts,
        user: row[1] || '',
        action: row[2] || '',
        recordId: row[3] || '',
        details: row[4] || ''
      };
    })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return b.timestampMs - a.timestampMs || a.row - b.row; })
```

Now Auth.js adminGetUserActivity:

```js
function adminGetUserActivity(token) {
  requireAdmin_(token);

  const sheet = getAuditSheet_();
  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) {
    return { users: [], recent: [], totals: { events: 0, logins: 0, activeUsers: 0 } };
  }

  const startRow = Math.max(2, lastRow - CONFIG.USERS.ACTIVITY_LIMIT + 1);
  const values = sheet.getRange(startRow, 1, lastRow - startRow + 1, 5).getValues();

  const parsed = values.map(function (row) {
    return {
      ts: auditTimestampMs_(row[0]),
      timestamp: row[0] ? row[0].toString() : '',
      email: String(row[1] || '').toLowerCase().trim() || '(system)',
      action: String(row[2] || ''),
      recordId: row[3] || '',
      details: row[4] || ''
    };
  });

  parsed.sort(function (a, b) { return b.ts - a.ts; });

  const recent = parsed.slice(0, 30).map(function (row) {
    return { timestamp: row.timestamp, user: row.email, action: row.action, recordId: row.recordId, details: row.details };
  });

  const perUser = {};
  let logins = 0;
  parsed.forEach(function (row) {
    if (!perUser[row.email]) {
      perUser[row.email] = { email: row.email, actions: 0, logins: 0, lastSeenMs: -1, lastSeen: '' };
    }
    perUser[row.email].actions++;
    if (row.ts > perUser[row.email].lastSeenMs) {
      perUser[row.email].lastSeenMs = row.ts;
      perUser[row.email].lastSeen = row.timestamp;
    }
    if (row.action === ACTIONS.LOGIN) {
      perUser[row.email].logins++;
      logins++;
    }
  });

  const userList = Object.keys(perUser)
    .map(function (k) { return perUser[k]; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return b.actions - a.actions; });

  return {
    users: userList,
    recent: recent,
    totals: { events: values.length, logins: logins, activeUsers: userList.length }
  };
}
```

```json
  "content": "const fs = require('fs');\nconst raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));\n\nconst ts = (v) => {\n  if (!v) return 0;\n  const d = new Date(v);\n  return isFinite(d.getTime()) ? d.getTime() : 0;\n};\n\nconst byRow = raw.slice().sort((a, b) => a.row - b.row);\n\nconsole.log('== NEW server order (numeric ts desc), first 8 ==');\nbyRow.slice().sort((a, b) => ts(b.timestamp) - ts(a.timestamp)).slice(0, 8)\n  .forEach((e) => console.log('  ' + (e.timestamp || '(empty)')));\n\nconsole.log('== OLD client string-desc order, first 8 ==');\nbyRow.slice().sort((a, b) => String(b.timestamp).toLowerCase().localeCompare(String(a.timestamp).toLowerCase())).slice(0, 8)\n  .forEach((e) => console.log('  ' + (e.timestamp || '(empty)')));\n\nconsole.log('== NEW recent activity top 5 (by ts desc) ==');\nbyRow.slice().sort((a, b) => ts(b.timestamp) - ts(a.timestamp)).slice(0, 5)\n  .forEach((e) => console.log('  ' + (e.user || '(system)') + ' :: ' + (e.action || '') + ' :: ' + (e.timestamp || '(empty)')));\n\nconsole.log('== OLD recent-activity (first 30 physical rows, reversed) top 5 ==');\nbyRow.slice(0, 30).slice().reverse().slice(0, 5)\n  .forEach((e) => console.log('  ' + (e.user || '(system)') + ' :: ' + (e.action || '') + ' :: ' + (e.timestamp || '(empty)')));\n\nconst empties = byRow.filter((e) => !e.timestamp).length;\nconsole.log('empty timestamps: ' + empties + ' of ' + byRow.length);\n"
}
```

Both bugs fixed and deployed **@147** (live at the exec URL). Commits `201d7ad` + `9a72ba6` pushed to origin/main.

**Bug 1 — Customize logged you out:** arg-order mismatch. Client sends `(prefs, token)` but server was `saveDashboardPreferences(token, prefs)`, so the prefs object was used as the session token → `requireLogin_` threw "Login required" → client auto-logout. Fixed server signature to token-last (`DashboardStudio.js:63`). Live call now returns the proper "Login required" only for genuinely bad tokens.

**Bug 2 — counters 0,0,0 after update:** `addItem`/`updateItem`/`deleteItem` returned raw `getData()` (no `summary`/`analytics`), but the client handlers do `appState.summary = data.summary || {}`, wiping the KPI values. Fixed all three in `code.js` to return a full `getAppData(token)` payload, so counters update instantly after add/update/delete (also respects per-user scoping). `markReviewDone` was unaffected (already returned summary).

Note: since these fixes are server-side only, no client files changed — but browsers may cache `app.js`, so a hard refresh (Ctrl+F5) is still recommended. Both fixes are also covered by the offline queue (replays same args; return shape is ignored there).

So `applyDashboardPreferences()` throws `ReferenceError: switchView is not defined`!

```js
ApiService.saveDashboardPreferences(prefs).then(function () {
    hideOverlay();
    showToast('Dashboard preferences saved.', 'success');   // success toast shows
    appState.dashboardPrefs = prefs;
    applyDashboardPreferences();   // THROWS ReferenceError: switchView is not defined
  })
```

When `applyDashboardPreferences()` throws inside the `.then` callback, the exception becomes a REJECTED promise from that `.then`, which flows to the `.catch`:

```js
.catch(function (err) {
    hideOverlay();
    if (handleServerFailure(err)) return;   // not auth error → returns false
    showToast('Could not save preferences.', 'error');   // ERROR TOAST SHOWS!
});
```

**THAT'S IT!** The success toast shows first, then `applyDashboardPreferences()` throws `ReferenceError: switchView is not defined`, which the `.catch` catches and displays "Could not save preferences." — so BOTH toasts appear simultaneously!

So the dual-toast bug is NOT a double invocation — it's the error in `.then` being caught by `.catch`. 

Also the dialog doesn't close because `closeColumnDialog()` is never called in the success handler (and even if it were called before applyDashboardPreferences, applyDashboardPreferences crashes).

```js
function columnVisible_(field) {
  const prefs = appState.dashboardPrefs || {};
  const columns = prefs.columns || {};
  const label = String(field && field.label || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (label === '#' || label === 'id' || label === 'sr no') return columns.id !== false;
  if (label === 'sector') return columns.sector !== false;
  if (label === 'description') return columns.description !== false;
  if (label.indexOf('entry') !== -1) return columns.entryDate !== false;
  if (label.indexOf('review') !== -1) return columns.reviewDate !== false;
  if (label.indexOf('action') !== -1) return columns.actions !== false;
  return true;
}
```

```js
function dashboardColumnKey_(label) {
  const l = String(label || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (l === '#' || l === 'id' || l === 'sr no' || l === 'sr no.') return 'id';
  if (l === 'sector') return 'sector';
  if (l === 'description') return 'description';
  if (l.indexOf('entry') !== -1) return 'entryDate';
  if (l.indexOf('review') !== -1) return 'reviewDate';
  if (l.indexOf('action') !== -1) return 'actions';
  return '';
}

function dashboardColumnVisible_(label) {
  const columns = (appState.dashboardPrefs && appState.dashboardPrefs.columns) || {};
  const key = dashboardColumnKey_(label);
  return key ? columns[key] !== false : true;
}
```

```json
}
```

## Assistant (Build · big-pickle · 6.1s)

All three symptoms traced to client-side bugs, fixed and deployed **@149** (commit `b893e47`).

**Root cause of "both toasts":** `applyDashboardPreferences()` called `switchView(...)`, which doesn't exist (the real function is `toggleDashboardView`). So after the success toast, it threw a `ReferenceError` inside the `.then`, which the `.catch` then reported as "Could not save preferences." — one save, two toasts, and the crash also blocked any view change or re-render.

Fixes (applied identically to `app.js`, `script.html`, `docs/app.js`):
- `applyDashboardPreferences` now calls `toggleDashboardView(...)` → applies the saved view mode and re-renders (also fixes the silent fallback-to-defaults on page load).
- Save now calls `closeColumnDialog()` on success → dialog closes automatically.

## Assistant (Build · big-pickle · 10.8s)

_Thinking:_

Now I understand the current Gemini implementation:

**How `getAiInsights` works today:**
1. `getAiInsights(token)` — admin-gated (if token provided).
2. Reads `ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS.AI_INSIGHTS` → checks `enabled` and `apiKey`.
3. Builds a minimal prompt with summary counts.
4. Calls Gemini `generateContent` endpoint with `?key=API_KEY`.
5. Returns `{success: true, insights: text}`.

**Where the key currently comes from:** `ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS.AI_INSIGHTS.apiKey` (a constant in code, placeholder ''). The proper way to make it live without committing a secret: put the key in **Script Properties** (`AI_INSIGHTS_API_KEY` or similar). But note: `getAiInsights` reads only from the static constant — it does NOT check Script Properties for the key. There's `getEnterpriseConfig_` which reads Script Properties but `getAiInsights` doesn't use it.

So to make the feature live:
1. Get the API key from the user.

```js
function getAiInsights(token) {
  if (token) requireAdmin_(token);
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var aiEnabled = props.getProperty('AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED') === 'true' || ai.enabled === true;
  if (!aiEnabled) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  }
  var apiKey = props.getProperty('GEMINI_API_KEY') || ai.apiKey || '';
  if (!apiKey) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI credentials are not configured.' };
  }
  var data = getData();
  var summary = buildSummaryFromItems(data.items || []);
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard: total=' + summary.total + ', reviewDue=' + summary.flagged +
    ', normal=' + summary.normal + '. Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions.';
  var endpoint = ai.endpoint || ENTERPRISE_AI_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT;
  try {
    var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch(endpoint + '?key=' + encodeURIComponent(apiKey), {
      method: 'post',
      contentType: 'application/json',
      payload: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] }),
      muteHttpExceptions: true
    });
    var body = JSON.parse(resp.getContentText());
    var code = resp.getResponseCode();
    if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
      var apiErr = body && body.error && (body.error.message || body.error.status);
      return { success: false, message: apiErr || ('Gemini HTTP ' + code) };
    }
    var text = body && body.candidates && body.candidates[0] && body.candidates[0].content &&
      body.candidates[0].content.parts && body.candidates[0].content.parts[0] &&
      body.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
    if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'No text returned by Gemini.' };
    return { success: true, insights: text };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: String(err) };
  }
```

Implementation in `getAiInsights`:
```js
function getAiInsights(token) {
  if (token) requireAdmin_(token);
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var aiEnabled = props.getProperty('AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED') === 'true' || ai.enabled === true;
  if (!aiEnabled) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  }
  var provider = (props.getProperty('AI_PROVIDER') || ai.provider || 'openrouter').toLowerCase();
  var apiKey = props.getProperty(provider === 'gemini' ? 'GEMINI_API_KEY' : 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY') || ai.apiKey || '';
  if (!apiKey) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI credentials are not configured.' };
  }
  var data = getData();
  var summary = buildSummaryFromItems(data.items || []);
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard: total=' + summary.total + ', reviewDue=' + summary.flagged +
    ', normal=' + summary.normal + '. Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions.';
  var model = props.getProperty('AI_MODEL') || ai.model || 'openai/gpt-4o-mini';
  try {
    var result = (provider === 'gemini')
      ? callGemini_(ai, apiKey, model, prompt)
      : callOpenRouter_(apiKey, model, prompt);
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: String(err) };
  }
}
```

`callOpenRouter_(apiKey, model, prompt)`:
```js
function callOpenRouter_(apiKey, model, prompt) {
  var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions', {
    method: 'post',
    contentType: 'application/json',
    headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + apiKey },
    payload: JSON.stringify({
      model: model,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
    }),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  });
  var body = JSON.parse(resp.getContentText());
  var code = resp.getResponseCode();
  if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
    var apiErr = body && body.error && (body.error.message || body.error.status || body.error.type);
    return { success: false, message: apiErr || ('OpenRouter HTTP ' + code) };
  }
  var text = body && body.choices && body.choices[0] && body.choices[0].message && body.choices[0].message.content;
  if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'No text returned by OpenRouter.' };
  return { success: true, insights: text };
}
```

`callGemini_`:
```js
function callGemini_(ai, apiKey, model, prompt) {
  var endpoint = ai.endpoint || ENTERPRISE_AI_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT;
  var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch(endpoint + '?key=' + encodeURIComponent(apiKey), {
    method: 'post',
    contentType: 'application/json',
    payload: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] }),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  });
  var body = JSON.parse(resp.getContentText());
  var code = resp.getResponseCode();
  if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
    var apiErr = body && body.error && (body.error.message || body.error.status);
    return { success: false, message: apiErr || ('Gemini HTTP ' + code) };
  }
  var text = body && body.candidates && body.candidates[0] && body.candidates[0].content &&
    body.candidates[0].content.parts && body.candidates[0].content.parts[0] &&
    body.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
  if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'No text returned by Gemini.' };
  return { success: true, insights: text };
}
```

New implementation:

```
function getAiInsights(token) {
  if (token) requireAdmin_(token);
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var aiEnabled = props.getProperty('AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED') === 'true' || ai.enabled === true;
  if (!aiEnabled) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  }
  var provider = (props.getProperty('AI_PROVIDER') || ai.provider || 'openrouter').toLowerCase();
  var apiKey = props.getProperty(provider === 'gemini' ? 'GEMINI_API_KEY' : 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY') || ai.apiKey || '';
  if (!apiKey) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI credentials are not configured.' };
  }
  var data = getData();
  var summary = buildSummaryFromItems(data.items || []);
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard: total=' + summary.total + ', reviewDue=' + summary.flagged +
    ', normal=' + summary.normal + '. Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions.';
  var model = props.getProperty('AI_MODEL') || ai.model || (provider === 'gemini' ? 'gemini-2.0-flash' : 'openai/gpt-4o-mini');
  try {
    return provider === 'gemini'
      ? callGemini_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt)
      : callOpenRouter_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt);
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: String(err) };
  }
}

function getAIInsights(token) { return getAiInsights(token); }

function callOpenRouter_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt) {
  var endpoint = props.getProperty('OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT') || ai.endpoint || ENTERPRISE_AI_OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT;
  var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch(endpoint, {
    method: 'post',
    contentType: 'application/json',
    headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + apiKey },
    payload: JSON.stringify({
      model: model,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
    }),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  });
  var body = JSON.parse(resp.getContentText());
  var code = resp.getResponseCode();
  if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
    var apiErr = body && body.error && (body.error.message || body.error.type || body.error.status);
    return { success: false, message: apiErr || ('OpenRouter HTTP ' + code) };
  }
  var text = body && body.choices && body.choices[0] && body.choices[0].message &&
    body.choices[0].message.content;
  if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'No text returned by OpenRouter.' };
  return { success: true, insights: text };
}

function callGemini_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt) {
  var endpoint = props.getProperty('GEMINI_ENDPOINT') || ENTERPRISE_AI_DEFAULT_ENDPOINT;
  var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch(endpoint + '?key=' + encodeURIComponent(apiKey), {
    method: 'post',
    contentType: 'application/json',
    payload: JSON.stringify({
      contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
      generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'text/plain' }
    }),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  });
  var body = JSON.parse(resp.getContentText());
  var code = resp.getResponseCode();
  if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
    var apiErr = body && body.error && (body.error.message || body.error.status);
    return { success: false, message: apiErr || ('Gemini HTTP ' + code) };
  }
  var text = body && body.candidates && body.candidates[0] && body.candidates[0].content &&
    body.candidates[0].content.parts && body.candidates[0].content.parts[0] &&
    body.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
  if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'No text returned by Gemini.' };
  return { success: true, insights: text };
}

/* Admin-gated: stores the active provider API key in Script Properties so the
   real credential is never committed to the repo. Never echoes the value back. */
function setAiApiKey(token, apiKey) {
  requireAdmin_(token);
  if (!apiKey || typeof apiKey !== 'string' || !apiKey.trim()) {
    return { ok: false, message: 'Missing API key.' };
  }
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var provider = (props.getProperty('AI_PROVIDER') || (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS.provider || 'openrouter').toLowerCase();
  props.setProperty(provider === 'gemini' ? 'GEMINI_API_KEY' : 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY', apiKey.trim());
  return { ok: true };
}

function setGeminiApiKey(token, apiKey) {
  return setAiApiKey(token, apiKey);
}

function setOpenRouterApiKey(token, apiKey) {
  return setAiApiKey(token, apiKey);
}

function aiKeyConfigured_() {
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var provider = (props.getProperty('AI_PROVIDER') || ai.provider || 'openrouter').toLowerCase();
  var propName = provider === 'gemini' ? 'GEMINI_API_KEY' : 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY';
  return !!props.getProperty(propName) || !!ai.apiKey;
}
```

```
**India – A Quick Overview**

| Category | Highlights |
|----------|------------|
| **Official Name** | Republic of India (Bhārat) |
| **Capital** | New Delhi |
| **Population** | ~1.42 billion (2024) – 2nd most populous country |
| **Area** | 3.29 million km² (7th largest country) |
| **Languages** | Constitution recognises **22 official languages**; Hindi + English are the official languages of the Union Government; hundreds of regional tongues (e.g., Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Punjabi, Assamese) |
| **Religions** | ~79% Hindu, 13% Muslim, 2% Christian, 1.5% Sikh, 1% Buddhist, 2.5% other (including Jain, Parsi, etc.) |
| **Government** | Federal parliamentary republic – 28 states + 8 union territories |
| **Currency** | Indian rupee (INR) |
| **Time zones** | IST = UTC + 5:30 (single time zone) |
| **Calling code** | +91 |
| **Internet TLD** | .in |

---

### 1️⃣ Geography & Climate
- **Location:** South Asia, between Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Pakistan; coastline of ~7,500 km on the Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal.
- **Major Physical Features:** 
  - **Indus‑Gangetic Plains** – fertile alluvial belt where many megacities (Delhi, Kolkata, Lucknow) lie.  
  - **Thar Desert** – arid region in Rajasthan.  
  - **Western Ghats & Eastern Ghats** – mountain ranges running parallel to the west and east coasts.  
  - **Himalayas** – the world’s highest mountain range, containing some of the world’s highest peaks (e.g., Kangchenjunga) and the source of major rivers.  
  - **Coastal Plains** – low‑lying, tropical marshes (e.g., Sundarbans) and bustling ports (Mumbai, Cochin, Chennai).  
- **Climate:** Monsoon‑driven; broadly three seasons – **hot (Mar‑May)**, **monsoon (Jun‑Sep)**, and **cool/dry (Oct‑Feb)**. Northern highlands see snow in winter, while the far south stays warm year‑round.

---

### 2️⃣ Economy
| Indicator | Value (2023‑24) |
|-----------|---------------|
| **GDP (nominal)** | ≈ US$ 3.5 trillion (5th largest world economy) |
| **GDP per capita** | ≈ US$ 2,500 (modest, but highly unequal) |
| **Key Sectors** | Services (IT, BPO, finance) ≈ 55% of GDP; Manufacturing (automobiles, pharmaceuticals, chemicals) ≈ 20%; Agriculture ≈ 15%; Industry & construction ≈ 10% |
| **Exports** | Pharmaceuticals, software, engineering goods, textiles, gems & jewelry, automotive parts, agricultural produce |
| **Major Trade Partners** | USA, China, United Arab Emirates, Singapore, United Kingdom |
| **Infrastructure Highlights** | • 3,200 km of national highways; • 17 major ports (including Mumbai, Kandla, Chennai, Vishakhapatnam); • Over 10,000 km of railway network, one of the world’s busiest; • 130 + operational airports (including 7 international hubs) |
| **Startup Ecosystem** | 100 + unicorns as of 2024; fintech, health‑tech, agritech, ed‑tech, and space tech are fast‑growing segments |

---

### 3️⃣ Culture & Society
- **Cuisine:** Diverse – staples include rice, wheat flour (roti/naan), lentils, and a vast array of spice‑based dishes. Famous regional cuisines include Butter Chicken (Punjab), Dosa & Rasam (South), Biryani (Hyderabad), and Vada Pav (Maharashtra).  
- **Arts & Entertainment:** 
  - **Music:** Classical (Hindustani & Carnatic), Bollywood film music, folk traditions.  
  - **Dance:** Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kathakali, Manipuri, and others.  
  - **Cinema:** Bollywood (Hindi film industry) is the world’s largest by ticket sales; South Indian cinema (Tollywood, Kollywood, etc.) also produces massive output.  
  - **Literature:** Ancient epics such as the **Mahabharata** and **Ramayana**, modern writers like Rabindran Tagore (Nobel laureate, 1913).  
- **Religious & Social Life:** Festivals are celebrated by all faiths (e.g., **Diwali**, **Durga Puja**, **Eid**, **Christmas**, **Holi**, **Ramzan**, **Navratri**). Joint families and extended kin networks remain common, though nuclear families are rising in urban centers.  
- **Sports:** Cricket dominates (World Cup winners 1983, 2011, 2022), but football, badminton, wrestling, and traditional games like kho‑kho and kabaddi also have strong followings.  

---

### 4️⃣ Tourism Hotspots
| Region | Must‑See Destinations | Highlights |
|--------|----------------------|------------|
| **Northern Plains** | Delhi, Agra (Taj Mahal), Jaipur (Pink City) | Heritage forts, UNESCO World Heritage Sites |
| **Himalayan North** | Dharamshala, Ladakh, Rishikesh, Manali | Trekking, pilgrimage sites, adventure sports |
| **Western Coast** | Goa (beaches), Mumbai (gateway to Bollywood), Pune, Kerala backwaters | Seaside resorts, nightlife, historic ports |
| **Eastern Coast** | Kolkata, Puri (Jagannath), Northeast (Darjeeling, Assam tea estates) | Colonial architecture, tea culture |
| **South India** | Hyderabad (Charminar), Chennai, Bengaluru (IT hub), Cochin, Ooty | Classical music/dance, spice plantations, beaches |
| **Spiritual/Tourist Sites** | Tirupati, Varanasi, Rishikesh, Mahabodhi (Bodh Gaya) | Pilgrimage and meditation centers |

---

### 5️⃣ Challenges & Opportunities (Key Talking Points)
| Challenge | Why It Matters | Emerging Opportunity |
|-----------|----------------|----------------------|
| **Water scarcity & climate change** | Heavy dependence on monsoon rains; over‑extraction of groundwater. | Renewable‑energy‑powered desalination, rain‑water harvesting, climate‑resilient agriculture. |
| **Population pressure & urbanization** | Megacities face traffic congestion, waste management, housing deficits. | Smart‑city tech, affordable housing models, decentralized urban planning. |
| **Skill mismatch** | Large youth labor force but gaps in employable skills. | Massive upskilling programs, public‑private partnerships in digital & technical training. |
| **Income inequality** | Rural‑urban gap widens; regional disparities exist. | Inclusive growth initiatives, micro‑finance, empowerment of women‑led enterprises. |
| **Geopolitical position** | Strategic location in the Indian Ocean; border tensions with neighbors. | Leveraging “Act East” policy to boost trade, maritime connectivity, and soft power. |
```

```
/* OpenAI-compatible chat completions (used by OpenRouter and Groq). */
function callOpenAiChat_(endpoint, apiKey, model, prompt) {
  var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch(endpoint, {
    method: 'post',
    contentType: 'application/json',
    headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + apiKey },
    payload: JSON.stringify({
      model: model,
      messages: [
        {
          role: 'system',
          content: 'You are a concise data-analytics assistant for the India Post Haryana dashboard. ' +
            'The user gives current dashboard summary numbers. Respond ONLY with exactly 3 short bullet ' +
            'points of concrete follow-up actions derived from those numbers. Do not describe India, ' +
            'its geography, history, or culture.'
        },
        { role: 'user', content: prompt }
      ]
    }),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  });
  var body = JSON.parse(resp.getContentText());
  var code = resp.getResponseCode();
  if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
    var apiErr = body && body.error && (body.error.message || body.error.type || body.error.status);
    return { success: false, message: apiErr || ('Provider HTTP ' + code) };
  }
  var text = body && body.choices && body.choices[0] && body.choices[0].message &&
    body.choices[0].message.content;
  if (!text) return { success: false, message: 'No text returned by AI provider.' };
  return { success: true, insights: text };
}

/* OpenRouter chat completions. */
function callOpenRouter_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt) {
  var endpoint = props.getProperty('OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT') || ai.endpoint || ENTERPRISE_AI_OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT;
  return callOpenAiChat_(endpoint, apiKey, model, prompt);
}

/* Groq chat completions (free tier). */
function callGroq_(props, apiKey, model, prompt) {
  var endpoint = props.getProperty('GROQ_ENDPOINT') || ENTERPRISE_AI_GROQ_ENDPOINT;
  return callOpenAiChat_(endpoint, apiKey, model, prompt);
}
```

```js
/* ---------------------------------- AI Insights ---------------------------------- */

function openAiInsights() {
  if (!appState.isAdmin) { showToast('Admin access required', 'error'); return; }
  openDialog('aiInsightsModal');
  aiInsights();
}

function closeAiInsights() {
  closeDialog('aiInsightsModal');
}

function aiInsights() {
  const list = getEl('aiInsightsList');
  const loading = getEl('aiInsightsLoading');
  const regen = getEl('aiInsightsRegen');
  if (list) list.innerHTML = '';
  if (loading) loading.style.display = 'flex';
  if (regen) regen.disabled = true;
  ApiService.getAiInsights().then(function (data) {
    if (!data || data.success !== true) {
      const msg = (data && data.message) || 'Could not generate AI insights.';
      showToast(msg, 'error');
      renderAiInsight(msg, true);
      return;
    }
    renderAiInsight(data.insights || '', false);
  }).catch(function (err) {
    if (handleServerFailure(err)) return;
    const msg = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err || 'Unknown error');
    showToast(msg, 'error');
    renderAiInsight(msg, true);
  }).then(function () {
    if (loading) loading.style.display = 'none';
    if (regen) regen.disabled = false;
  });
}

function renderAiInsight(text, isError) {
  const list = getEl('aiInsightsList');
  if (!list) return;
  if (isError) {
    list.innerHTML = '<li style="color:var(--danger,#dc3545);">' + escapeHtml(text) + '</li>';
    return;
  }
  const lines = String(text || '').split(/\r?\n/).map(function (s) { return s.replace(/^[-*•\s]+/, '').trim(); })
    .filter(function (s) { return s; });
  const items = lines.length ? lines : [String(text || '')];
  list.innerHTML = items.map(function (line) {
    return '<li style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;">' +
      '<span style="color:var(--accent,#2563eb);">•</span>' +
      '<span>' + escapeHtml(line) + '</span></li>';
  }).join('');
}
```

```
/* ---------------------------------- AI Insights ---------------------------------- */

function openAiInsights() {
  if (!appState.isAdmin) { showToast('Admin access required', 'error'); return; }
  openDialog('aiInsightsModal');
  aiInsights();
}

function closeAiInsights() {
  closeDialog('aiInsightsModal');
}

function aiInsights() {
  const list = getEl('aiInsightsList');
  const loading = getEl('aiInsightsLoading');
  const regen = getEl('aiInsightsRegen');
  if (list) list.innerHTML = '';
  if (loading) loading.style.display = 'flex';
  if (regen) regen.disabled = true;
  ApiService.getAiInsights().then(function (data) {
    if (!data || data.success !== true) {
      const msg = (data && data.message) || 'Could not generate AI insights.';
      showToast(msg, 'error');
      renderAiInsight(msg, true);
      return;
    }
    renderAiInsight(data.insights || '', false);
  }).catch(function (err) {
    if (handleServerFailure(err)) return;
    const msg = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err || 'Unknown error');
    showToast(msg, 'error');
    renderAiInsight(msg, true);
  }).then(function () {
    if (loading) loading.style.display = 'none';
    if (regen) regen.disabled = false;
  });
}

function renderAiInsight(text, isError) {
  const list = getEl('aiInsightsList');
  if (!list) return;
  if (isError) {
    list.innerHTML = '<li style="color:var(--danger,#dc3545);">' + escapeHtml(text) + '</li>';
    return;
  }
  const lines = String(text || '').split(/\r?\n/).map(function (line) {
    return line.replace(/^[-*\u2022\u25CF\s]+/, '').trim();
  }).filter(function (line) { return line; });
  const items = lines.length ? lines : [String(text || '')];
  list.innerHTML = items.map(function (line) {
    return '<li style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;">' +
      '<span style="color:var(--accent,#2563eb);font-weight:700;">&rsaquo;</span>' +
      '<span>' + escapeHtml(line) + '</span></li>';
  }).join('');
}

/* ---------------------------------- In-page link preview ---------------------------------- */
```

## AI Insights v2 — design

### Shared server plumbing (`EnterpriseService.gs`)
Refactor the existing provider resolution into one reusable path so both new endpoints stay provider-swappable (Groq/HF/OpenRouter/Gemini):
- `resolveAiConfig_()` → `{ provider, apiKey, model, props }` (reuses `aiKeyPropName_`, `aiDefaultModel_`, existing gates)
- `generateAiText_(prompt)` → dispatches to `callGroq_`/`callHuggingFace_`/etc. with the existing "3 bullets" system prompt

### 1. Per-card AI insight
- **`getCardAiInsight(token, row)`** — admin-gated (same pattern as `getAiInsights`)
  - Looks up the record from `getData()` by `row`
  - Prompt from that record only: `id, sector, description, action, responsibility, entryDate, reviewDate, reviewStatus, submission count, linkUrl`
  - Returns `{ success, insights }` (2–3 short bullets, ≤ ~60 words)
- **UI**: small "AI" button on each card action row (`buildCardHtml`) and a per-row button in table view (`buildTableRowHtml`) — shown only to admins, mirroring the existing AI Insights button. Result renders in a shared modal (`#cardAiModal`, cloned from `aiInsightsModal` with a per-record title) or as an inline collapsible line under the card.

### 2. Hyperlink content analysis
- **`getLinkContentAiInsight(token, row)`** — admin-gated
  - Reads the record's `linkUrl` (already extracted in `Utils.js:212`)
  - **SSRF guard**: only `http(s)://`; block localhost/private ranges (`10.*, 172.16–31.*, 192.168.*, 127.*, 169.254.169.254`); fetch timeout ~15s; cap extracted text (~25KB)
  - **Fetch + extract**: `UrlFetchApp` → strip HTML tags via a new `htmlToText_()` helper; for Google Drive/Docs links, convert to `docs.google.com/document/d/<id>/export?format=txt` (works for "anyone with link" files)
  - **Fallback**: if the fetch is blocked/private/fails, it does *not* hard-error — Groq gets the URL + link display text only, and the response notes "link content not readable"
  - Returns `{ success, insights, source, contentRead }`
- **UI**: an "Analyze link" button in the record detail modal (`recordDetailModal`) and next to linked fields on cards — renders into the same modal.

```json
}
```

```
});
```

For table view: `tableRowAi(row, btn)`:
```
function tableRowAi(row, btn) {
  if (!appState.isEditor) { showToast('Admin/editor access required', 'warning'); return; }
  var tr = btn.closest('tr');
  var existing = tr.nextElementSibling;
  if (existing && existing.classList && existing.classList.contains('ai-insight-tr')) {
    existing.remove();
    return;
  }
  var panelTr = document.createElement('tr');
  panelTr.className = 'ai-insight-tr';
  var td = document.createElement('td');
  td.setAttribute('colspan', '7');
  td.className = 'card-ai-panel';
  td.innerHTML = cardAiPanelSkeleton_();
  panelTr.appendChild(td);
  tr.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', panelTr);
  loadCardAi(td, row);
}
```

```
function generateAiText_(prompt, systemPrompt) {
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var provider = (props.getProperty('AI_PROVIDER') || ai.provider || 'openrouter').toLowerCase();
  var apiKey = props.getProperty(aiKeyPropName_(provider)) || ai.apiKey || '';
  if (!apiKey) return { success: false, message: 'AI credentials are not configured.' };
  var model = props.getProperty('AI_MODEL') || ai.model || aiDefaultModel_(provider);
  try {
    if (provider === 'gemini') return callGemini_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
    if (provider === 'groq') return callGroq_(props, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
    if (provider === 'huggingface') return callHuggingFace_(props, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
    return callOpenRouter_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: String(err) };
  }
}
```

```
function getAiInsights(token) {
  if (token) requireAdmin_(token);
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var aiEnabled = props.getProperty('AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED') === 'true' || ai.enabled === true;
  if (!aiEnabled) return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  var data = getData();
  var summary = buildSummaryFromItems(data.items || []);
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard: total=' + summary.total + ', reviewDue=' + summary.flagged +
    ', normal=' + summary.normal + '. Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions.';
  return generateAiText_(prompt, ENTERPRISE_AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT);
}
```

7. `getCardAiInsight(token, row)`:
```
function getCardAiInsight(token, row) {
  requireEditor_(token);
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var aiEnabled = props.getProperty('AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED') === 'true' || ai.enabled === true;
  if (!aiEnabled) return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  var item = findItemByRow_(row);
  if (!item) return { success: false, message: 'Record not found.' };
  var linkUrl = firstLinkUrl_(item);
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard record #' + (item.id || '') + ':\n' +
    'Sector: ' + (item.sector || '') + '\n' +
    'Description: ' + (item.description || '') + '\n' +
    'Action: ' + (item.action || '') + '\n' +
    'Responsibility: ' + (item.responsibility || '') + '\n' +
    'Entry date: ' + (item.entryDate || '') + '\n' +
    'Review date: ' + (item.reviewDate || '') + '\n' +
    'Review status: ' + (item.reviewStatus || '') + '\n' +
    (linkUrl ? ('Linked file URL: ' + linkUrl + '\n') : '') +
    'Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions for this record.';
  var result = generateAiText_(prompt, ENTERPRISE_AI_RECORD_SYSTEM_PROMPT);
  if (result.success === true) {
    result.row = item.row;
    result.id = item.id;
    result.hasLink = !!linkUrl;
  }
  return result;
```

8. `getLinkContentAiInsight(token, row)`:
```
function getLinkContentAiInsight(token, row) {
  requireEditor_(token);
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var aiEnabled = props.getProperty('AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED') === 'true' || ai.enabled === true;
  if (!aiEnabled) return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  var item = findItemByRow_(row);
  if (!item) return { success: false, message: 'Record not found.' };
  var url = firstLinkUrl_(item);
  if (!url) return { success: false, message: 'This record has no linked file.' };
  if (!isSafeLinkUrl_(url)) return { success: false, message: 'Unsafe link rejected.' };
  var fetchUrl = toReadableLinkUrl_(url);
  var contentRead = false;
  var text = '';
  try {
    var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch(fetchUrl, { muteHttpExceptions: true, timeoutSeconds: 15, followRedirects: false });
    if (resp.getResponseCode() >= 200 && resp.getResponseCode() < 300) {
      var body = resp.getContentText();
      if (body) {
        var lower = body.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.indexOf('<html') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('<!doctype') !== -1 || (resp.getHeaders()['content-type'] || '').indexOf('html') !== -1) {
          text = htmlToText_(body);
        } else {
          text = body;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) { text = ''; }
  text = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (text.length > ENTERPRISE_AI_LINK_MAX_CHARS) text = text.substring(0, ENTERPRISE_AI_LINK_MAX_CHARS);
  contentRead = text.length > 40;
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard record #' + (item.id || '') + ' (sector: ' + (item.sector || '') + ').\n' +
    'Linked file URL: ' + url + '\n' +
    (contentRead
      ? 'Linked file content: ' + text + '\n'
      : 'The linked file content could not be read (private, blocked, or unreadable). Base your answer on the record and URL only.\n') +
    'Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions.';
  var result = generateAiText_(prompt, ENTERPRISE_AI_RECORD_SYSTEM_PROMPT);
  if (result.success === true) {
    result.row = item.row;
    result.id = item.id;
    result.source = url;
    result.contentRead = contentRead;
  }
  return result;
}
```

9. Helpers `findItemByRow_(row)`, `firstLinkUrl_(item)`, `isSafeLinkUrl_(url)`, `toReadableLinkUrl_(url)`, `htmlToText_(html)`:
```
function findItemByRow_(row) {
  var data = getData();
  var items = data.items || [];
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (String(items[i].row) === String(row)) return items[i];
  }
  return null;
}

function firstLinkUrl_(item) {
  var links = (item && item.linkUrls) || {};
  if (links.action) return links.action;
  var keys = Object.keys(links);
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    if (links[keys[i]]) return links[keys[i]];
  }
  return '';
}

function isSafeLinkUrl_(url) {
  var parsed;
  try { parsed = new URL(url); } catch (err) { return false; }
  if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) return false;
  var host = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (host === 'localhost' || host.endsWith('.localhost') || host.endsWith('.local')) return false;
  if (/^127\./.test(host) || /^10\./.test(host) || /^192\.168\./.test(host) ||
      /^169\.254\./.test(host) || /^0\./.test(host)) return false;
  var m = host.match(/^172\.(\d+)\./);
  if (m) { var n = parseInt(m[1], 10); if (n >= 16 && n <= 31) return false; }
  return true;
}

function toReadableLinkUrl_(url) {
  var doc = url.match(/docs\.google\.com\/document\/d\/([^/?#]+)/);
  if (doc) return 'https://docs.google.com/document/d/' + doc[1] + '/export?format=txt';
  var file = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([^/?#]+)/);
  if (file) return 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + file[1];
  var open = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/open\?id=([^&#]+)/);
  if (open) return 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + open[1];
  return url;
}

function htmlToText_(html) {
  var s = String(html || '');
  s = s.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/&nbsp;/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/&amp;/gi, '&').replace(/&lt;/gi, '<').replace(/&gt;/gi, '>').replace(/&quot;/gi, '"').replace(/&#39;/gi, "'");
  s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return s;
}
```

Wait: `new URL(url)` — does Apps Script V8 support the `URL` global? Yes, Apps Script V8 supports `URL` and `URLSearchParams` (they're available in V8 runtime). Good. `.endsWith` is supported in V8 too.

One concern: `String.prototype.endsWith` — V8 supports it. Fine.

Also `Object.keys(links)` — fine.

5. Card panel functions:
```
function cardAiPanelHtml_() {
  return '<div class="card-ai-head">' +
    '<span class="card-ai-title">AI insight</span>' +
    '<button class="btn btn-small btn-ghost" type="button" onclick="collapseCardAi(this)">Collapse</button>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="card-ai-body"></div>';
}

function toggleCardAi(row, btn) {
  if (!appState.isEditor) { showToast('Admin/editor access required', 'warning'); return; }
  const article = btn.closest('.card');
  if (!article) return;
  let panel = article.querySelector('.card-ai-panel');
  if (panel) { panel.classList.toggle('card-ai-collapsed'); return; }
  panel = document.createElement('div');
  panel.className = 'card-ai-panel';
  panel.innerHTML = cardAiPanelHtml_();
  article.appendChild(panel);
  loadCardAi(panel, row);
}

function collapseCardAi(btn) {
  const panel = btn.closest('.card-ai-panel');
  if (panel) panel.classList.add('card-ai-collapsed');
}

function toggleRowAi(row, btn) {
  if (!appState.isEditor) { showToast('Admin/editor access required', 'warning'); return; }
  const tr = btn.closest('tr');
  if (!tr) return;
  const next = tr.nextElementSibling;
  if (next && next.classList && next.classList.contains('ai-insight-tr')) { next.remove(); return; }
  const panelTr = document.createElement('tr');
  panelTr.className = 'ai-insight-tr';
  const td = document.createElement('td');
  td.setAttribute('colspan', '7');
  td.className = 'card-ai-panel';
  td.innerHTML = cardAiPanelHtml_();
  panelTr.appendChild(td);
  tr.parentNode.insertBefore(panelTr, tr.nextSibling);
  loadCardAi(td, row);
}

function loadCardAi(panel, row) {
  const body = panel.querySelector('.card-ai-body');
  if (!body) return;
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="card-ai-loading">Generating insight…</div>';
  ApiService.getCardAiInsight(row).then(function (data) {
    if (!data || data.success !== true) {
      const msg = (data && data.message) || 'Could not generate AI insight.';
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="card-ai-error">' + escapeHtml(msg) + '</div>';
      return;
    }
    body.innerHTML = aiBulletsHtml_(data.insights || '', 'div');
    if (data.hasLink) {
      const linkWrap = document.createElement('div');
      linkWrap.className = 'card-ai-link';
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'btn btn-secondary btn-small';
      btn.setAttribute('type', 'button');
      btn.textContent = 'Analyze linked file';
      btn.setAttribute('onclick', 'loadLinkAi(this, ' + Number(row) + ')');
      linkWrap.appendChild(btn);
      body.appendChild(linkWrap);
    }
  }).catch(function (err) {
    if (handleServerFailure(err)) return;
    const msg = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err || 'Unknown error');
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="card-ai-error">' + escapeHtml(msg) + '</div>';
  });
}

function loadLinkAi(btn, row) {
  if (!appState.isEditor) { showToast('Admin/editor access required', 'warning'); return; }
  const body = btn.closest('.card-ai-body');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Analyzing…';
  const result = document.createElement('div');
  result.className = 'card-ai-link-result';
  if (body) body.appendChild(result);
  ApiService.getLinkContentAiInsight(row).then(function (data) {
    if (!data || data.success !== true) {
      const msg = (data && data.message) || 'Could not analyze the linked file.';
      result.innerHTML = '<div class="card-ai-error">' + escapeHtml(msg) + '</div>';
      return;
    }
    const head = '<div class="card-ai-link-label">' + escapeHtml(data.source || '') +
      (data.contentRead ? '' : ' <em>(content not readable — analyzed from record only)</em>') + '</div>';
    result.innerHTML = head + aiBulletsHtml_(data.insights || '', 'div');
  }).catch(function (err) {
    if (handleServerFailure(err)) return;
    const msg = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err || 'Unknown error');
    result.innerHTML = '<div class="card-ai-error">' + escapeHtml(msg) + '</div>';
  }).then(function () {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Analyze linked file';
  });
}
```

```
/* Shared provider dispatch: resolves the configured provider/key/model and
   runs a prompt through it. Returns {success, insights} or {success, message}. */
function generateAiText_(prompt, systemPrompt) {
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var provider = (props.getProperty('AI_PROVIDER') || ai.provider || 'openrouter').toLowerCase();
  var apiKey = props.getProperty(aiKeyPropName_(provider)) || ai.apiKey || '';
  if (!apiKey) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI credentials are not configured.' };
  }
  var model = props.getProperty('AI_MODEL') || ai.model || aiDefaultModel_(provider);
  try {
    if (provider === 'gemini') return callGemini_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
    if (provider === 'groq') return callGroq_(props, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
    if (provider === 'huggingface') return callHuggingFace_(props, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
    return callOpenRouter_(props, ai, apiKey, model, prompt, systemPrompt);
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: String(err) };
  }
}

function aiEnabled_() {
  var ai = (ENTERPRISE_SETTINGS || {}).AI_INSIGHTS || {};
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  return props.getProperty('AI_INSIGHTS_ENABLED') === 'true' || ai.enabled === true;
}

function findItemByRow_(row) {
  var items = getData().items || [];
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (String(items[i].row) === String(row)) return items[i];
  }
  return null;
}

function firstLinkUrl_(item) {
  var links = (item && item.linkUrls) || {};
  if (links.action) return links.action;
  var keys = Object.keys(links);
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    if (links[keys[i]]) return links[keys[i]];
  }
  return '';
}

/* Editor/admin-gated: AI insight for one record (its own fields only). */
function getCardAiInsight(token, row) {
  requireEditor_(token);
  if (!aiEnabled_()) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  }
  var item = findItemByRow_(row);
  if (!item) return { success: false, message: 'Record not found.' };
  var linkUrl = firstLinkUrl_(item);
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard record #' + (item.id || '') + ':\n' +
    'Sector: ' + (item.sector || '') + '\n' +
    'Description: ' + (item.description || '') + '\n' +
    'Action: ' + (item.action || '') + '\n' +
    'Responsibility: ' + (item.responsibility || '') + '\n' +
    'Entry date: ' + (item.entryDate || '') + '\n' +
    'Review date: ' + (item.reviewDate || '') + '\n' +
    'Review status: ' + (item.reviewStatus || '') + '\n' +
    (linkUrl ? 'Linked file URL: ' + linkUrl + '\n' : '') +
    'Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions for this record.';
  var result = generateAiText_(prompt, ENTERPRISE_AI_RECORD_SYSTEM_PROMPT);
  if (result.success === true) {
    result.row = item.row;
    result.id = item.id;
    result.hasLink = !!linkUrl;
  }
  return result;
}

/* Editor/admin-gated: fetches the record's linked file content (public URLs and
   "anyone with the link" Drive files only) and runs AI analysis over it. */
function getLinkContentAiInsight(token, row) {
  requireEditor_(token);
  if (!aiEnabled_()) {
    return { success: false, message: 'AI insights are not enabled.' };
  }
  var item = findItemByRow_(row);
  if (!item) return { success: false, message: 'Record not found.' };
  var url = firstLinkUrl_(item);
  if (!url) return { success: false, message: 'This record has no linked file.' };
  if (!isSafeLinkUrl_(url)) return { success: false, message: 'Unsafe link rejected.' };
  var fetchUrl = toReadableLinkUrl_(url);
  var text = '';
  try {
    var resp = UrlFetchApp.fetch(fetchUrl, { muteHttpExceptions: true, timeoutSeconds: 15, followRedirects: false });
    var code = resp.getResponseCode();
    if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
      var body = resp.getContentText();
      if (body) {
        var contentType = (resp.getHeaders()['content-type'] || '').toLowerCase();
        var lower = body.substring(0, 500).toLowerCase();
        if (lower.indexOf('<html') !== -1 || lower.indexOf('<!doctype') !== -1 || contentType.indexOf('html') !== -1) {
          text = htmlToText_(body);
        } else {
          text = body;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) { text = ''; }
  text = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (text.length > ENTERPRISE_AI_LINK_MAX_CHARS) text = text.substring(0, ENTERPRISE_AI_LINK_MAX_CHARS);
  var contentRead = text.length > 40;
  var prompt = 'India Post dashboard record #' + (item.id || '') + ' (sector: ' + (item.sector || '') + ').\n' +
    'Linked file URL: ' + url + '\n' +
    (contentRead
      ? 'Linked file content: ' + text + '\n'
      : 'The linked file content could not be read (private, blocked, or unreadable). Base your answer on the record and URL only.\n') +
    'Give exactly 3 concise bullet follow-up actions.';
  var result = generateAiText_(prompt, ENTERPRISE_AI_RECORD_SYSTEM_PROMPT);
  if (result.success === true) {
    result.row = item.row;
    result.id = item.id;
    result.source = url;
    result.contentRead = contentRead;
  }
  return result;
}

/* SSRF guard: only http(s), no localhost/private/link-local/metadata hosts. */
function isSafeLinkUrl_(url) {
  var parsed;
  try { parsed = new URL(url); } catch (err) { return false; }
  if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) return false;
  var host = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (host === 'localhost' || host.indexOf('.localhost') !== -1 || host.indexOf('.local') !== -1) return false;
  if (host === '169.254.169.254') return false;
  if (/^127\./.test(host) || /^10\./.test(host) || /^192\.168\./.test(host) || /^169\.254\./.test(host) || /^0\./.test(host)) return false;
  var m = host.match(/^172\.(\d+)\./);
  if (m) { var n = parseInt(m[1], 10); if (n >= 16 && n <= 31) return false; }
  return true;
}

/* Rewrites Google Drive/Docs links to plain-text-readable forms. */
function toReadableLinkUrl_(url) {
  var doc = url.match(/docs\.google\.com\/document\/d\/([^/?#]+)/);
  if (doc) return 'https://docs.google.com/document/d/' + doc[1] + '/export?format=txt';
  var file = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([^/?#]+)/);
  if (file) return 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + file[1];
  var open = url.match(/drive\.google\.com\/open\?id=([^&#]+)/);
  if (open) return 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + open[1];
  return url;
}

/* Crude HTML-to-text for link content extraction. */
function htmlToText_(html) {
  var s = String(html || '');
  s = s.replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/&nbsp;/gi, ' ');
  s = s.replace(/&amp;/gi, '&').replace(/&lt;/gi, '<').replace(/&gt;/gi, '>');
  s = s.replace(/&quot;/gi, '"').replace(/&#39;/gi, "'");
  s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return s;
}
```

```
function isSafeLinkUrl_(url) {
  var s = String(url || '').trim();
  var m = s.match(/^(https?):\/\/([^\/?#:]+)(?::(\d+))?([\/?#]|$)/i);
  if (!m) return false;
  if (m[1].toLowerCase() !== 'http' && m[1].toLowerCase() !== 'https') return false;
```

The regex `^(https?):\/\/([^\/?#:]+)(?::(\d+))?([\/?#]|$)` — `[^\/?#:]+` excludes `:` so ports aren't captured in the host part (they go to the optional port group). function fetchLinkText_(url) {

```
function fetchRawText_(url) {

}
```

- `.toast-container { position: fixed; top: var(--sp-2); right: var(--sp-2); z-index: 2000; ... }` (specificity 0,1,0)

```
    'UID:task-' + taskId + '-' + dateOnly,
```

```js
function fetchRawText_(url, maxHops) {
```

And `toAbsoluteUrl_`:
```js
function toAbsoluteUrl_(base, loc) {
  loc = String(loc || '').trim();
  if (!loc) return '';
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(loc)) return loc;
  if (loc.charAt(0) === '/') {
    var m = base.match(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/i);
    return m ? m[0] + loc : '';
  }
  var idx = base.lastIndexOf('/');
  return idx !== -1 ? base.substring(0, idx + 1) + loc : loc;
}
```

## Assistant (Build · big-pickle · 4.9s)

Fixed and live (@161, commit `8e51cc4`).

**Root cause:** the linked-file fetch used `followRedirects:false` and rejected any 3xx. Google's Sheets CSV export 302-redirects to `googleusercontent.com`, so it was skipped, and the fallback grabbed the raw `/edit` page — whose "JavaScript isn't enabled…" HTML passed the readability filter and became your preview.

**Fix (server only, no cache-buster bump needed):**
- `fetchRawText_` now follows redirects manually, validating every hop with the SSRF guard (so no internal-host redirects) and a 5-hop/loop cap.
- `toReadableLinkUrl_` preserves the link's `gid` so the exact sheet tab is exported.
- `isReadableAiText_` rejects Google boilerplate ("javascript isn't enabled", "can't be opened", "enable and reload", "browser version is no longer supported", etc.), so junk can never masquerade as content again.

Live-verified on row 6 — preview now shows the real data: `"BOs with Nil Parcel Booking from 01.08.2026 to 05.08.2026 — Division Name, Total BOs, No. of BOs with Nil Parcel booking…"`.

```js
function parseCsv_(csv) {
  var rows = [];
  var row = [];
  var cur = '';
  var inQ = false;
  var s = String(csv || '');
  for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    var c = s.charAt(i);
    if (inQ) {
      if (c === '"') {
        if (s.charAt(i + 1) === '"') { cur += '"'; i++; }
        else { inQ = false; }
      } else {
        cur += c;
      }
    } else if (c === '"') {
      inQ = true;
    } else if (c === ',') {
      row.push(cur); cur = '';
    } else if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') {
      if (c === '\r' && s.charAt(i + 1) === '\n') i++;
      row.push(cur); cur = '';
      rows.push(row); row = [];
    } else {
      cur += c;
    }
  }
  if (cur !== '' || row.length) { row.push(cur); rows.push(row); }
  return rows;
}
```
